prompt: Create a full-body high-fashion studio portrait of a fantasy humanoid ram faun, standing in a relaxed three-quarter pose against a plain warm gray-beige backdrop. The character has a pale lavender, speckled alien-like face and scalp, drooping sleepy eyes, a solemn neutral expression, long pointed elf ears with pink inner ears, and voluminous short curly white-blond hair around the sides of the head. Add exactly 2 enormous curved ram horns, one on each side, sweeping outward horizontally then curling forward and tapering to sharp tips, with realistic ridged brown horn texture. Dress the figure in avant-garde layered robes: an oversized cream-white kimono-like coat with huge padded sleeves and irregular dark indigo-black tie-dye blotches, draped over wrinkled off-white floor-length garments. Include a black textured scarf or collar at the neck, a few small pendant ornaments down the chest, soft beige cloth shoes, and a visible black-and-white checkerboard vertical panel along the right side of the lower outfit. Use realistic fashion editorial photography lighting, soft shadows, muted earthy tones, highly detailed fabric wrinkles and texture, centered composition, vertical 2:3 frame, full body visible from horns to shoes, minimal seamless studio floor and background. The subject should feel like an ethereal creature from an experimental couture runway look. Customize with humanoid ram faun, pale lavender with dark speckles, enormous ridged brown ram horns sweeping outward and curling forward, cream-white oversized robes with dark indigo-black tie-dye blotches, and solemn and sleepy.

promptZh: 创作一张全身高定摄影棚肖像，主角为奇幻类人羊角牧神，以放松的三分之二侧身姿势站立在纯净的暖灰米色背景前。角色拥有淡紫色且带有斑点的外星感面部和头皮，双眼微垂显得慵懒，表情庄重中性，长长的尖精灵耳内侧呈粉色，头部两侧有蓬松的短卷白金色头发。添加 2 只巨大的弯曲羊角，左右各一，水平向外延伸后向前卷曲并收尖，呈现逼真的棕色脊状角质纹理。为角色穿上前卫的层叠长袍：一件超大号奶油白和服式外套，配有巨大的垫肩袖和不规则的深靛黑色扎染斑点，披在褶皱的米白色落地长裙外。颈部搭配黑色纹理围巾或领饰，胸前垂挂少量吊坠装饰，脚穿柔软的米色布鞋，下装右侧可见黑白棋盘格垂直拼接面料。采用逼真的时尚杂志摄影布光，柔和阴影，低饱和度大地色系，高度细腻的织物褶皱与纹理，居中构图，2:3 竖构图比例，从羊角到鞋子全身可见，极简无缝摄影棚地面与背景。主体应呈现出一种来自实验性高定秀场的空灵生物感。可通过以下参数自定义：类人羊角牧神，带有深色斑点的淡紫色，向外延伸并向前卷曲的巨大棕色脊状羊角，带有深靛黑色扎染斑点的奶油白超大号长袍，以及 庄重且慵懒。
